-- =====================================================================
-- CCLF Bronze to Silver Raw Transformation Views (Databricks Delta)
-- Adheres strictly to the v5 Mapping Specification
-- Target Schema: cinqdev.silverraw_claims
-- Source Schema: cinqdev.bronze_claims
-- =====================================================================

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS cinqdev.silverraw_claims;

-- =====================================================================
-- 1) vw_claim_header
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_header AS
SELECT
  c1.batch_id AS batch_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
  'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
  'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
  'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
  CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
  CAST(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID AS STRING) AS source_claim_id,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82') THEN 'IP'
       WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('20', '30', '50', '60') THEN 'OP'
       WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('40', '45') THEN 'PROF'
       ELSE NULL
  END AS claim_type,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS source_resource_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS source_resource_type,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS source_format,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.BENE_MBI_ID), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.BENE_HIC_NUM), '')) AS patient_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS source_billing_org_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS source_rendering_org_id,
  CAST(cay.CLM_ACTV_CARE_FROM_DT AS DATE) AS admission_date,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_TYPE_CD) IN ('10', '71', '72', '81', '82') THEN CAST(c1.CLM_THRU_DT AS DATE)
       ELSE NULL
  END AS discharge_date,
  CAST(c1.CLM_FROM_DT AS DATE) AS statement_from,
  CAST(c1.CLM_THRU_DT AS DATE) AS statement_through,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS paid_date,
  CAST(c1.CLM_EFCTV_DT AS DATE) AS claim_effective_date,
  CAST(c1.CLM_IDR_LD_DT AS DATE) AS claim_received_date,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS claim_version_num,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ORG_CNTL_NUM), '') AS adjusted_claim_id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c1.DGNS_DRG_CD), '') AS drg_code,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS drg_code_system,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FAC_TYPE_CD), '') IS NULL 
            AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_CLSFCTN_CD), '') IS NULL 
            AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FREQ_CD), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
       ELSE CONCAT(
              COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FAC_TYPE_CD), ''), ''),
              COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_CLSFCTN_CD), ''), ''),
              COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BILL_FREQ_CD), ''), '')
            )
  END AS bill_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ADMSN_TYPE_CD), '') AS admission_type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ADMSN_SRC_CD), '') AS admission_source,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c1.BENE_PTNT_STUS_CD), '') AS discharge_status,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_ADJSMT_TYPE_CD) = '0' THEN 'ORIGINAL'
       WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_ADJSMT_TYPE_CD) = '1' THEN 'ADJUSTMENT'
       WHEN TRIM(c1.CLM_ADJSMT_TYPE_CD) = '2' THEN 'CANCELLATION'
       ELSE NULL
  END AS claim_adjustment_type_cd,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_MDCR_NPMT_RSN_CD), '') AS claim_status,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS reason_for_visit,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS actual_length_of_stay,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS covered_length_of_stay,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS line_of_business,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS product,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS primary_payer
FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c1 c1
LEFT JOIN cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_cay cay ON c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID = cay.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL;


-- =====================================================================
-- 2) vw_claim_line
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_line AS
WITH union_lines AS (
  -- cclf_c5 (Professional lines - Priority 1)
  SELECT
    c5.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_CNTL_NUM), ''), CONCAT(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, '-', CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS STRING))) AS source_line_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(c5.CLM_LINE_FROM_DT, c5.CLM_FROM_DT) AS DATE) AS service_date,
    CAST(COALESCE(c5.CLM_LINE_THRU_DT, c5.CLM_THRU_DT) AS DATE) AS service_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code_system,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_POS_CD), '') AS place_of_service,
    CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_SRVC_UNIT_QTY AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS billed_units,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS capitation_indicator,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.HCPCS_1_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_1,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.HCPCS_2_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_2,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.HCPCS_3_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_3,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.HCPCS_4_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_4,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.HCPCS_5_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_5,
    1 AS source_priority
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c5 c5
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c6 (DME/Carrier lines - Priority 2)
  SELECT
    c6.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_CNTL_NUM), ''), CONCAT(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, '-', CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS STRING))) AS source_line_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(c6.CLM_LINE_FROM_DT, c6.CLM_FROM_DT) AS DATE) AS service_date,
    CAST(COALESCE(c6.CLM_LINE_THRU_DT, c6.CLM_THRU_DT) AS DATE) AS service_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code_system,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_POS_CD), '') AS place_of_service,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS billed_units,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS capitation_indicator,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_1,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_2,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_3,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_4,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_5,
    2 AS source_priority
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c6 c6
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c2 (Institutional revenue lines - Priority 3)
  SELECT
    c2.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    CONCAT(c2.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, '-', CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM AS STRING)) AS source_line_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(c2.CLM_LINE_FROM_DT, c2.CLM_LINE_INSTNL_REV_CTR_DT, c2.CLM_FROM_DT) AS DATE) AS service_date,
    CAST(COALESCE(c2.CLM_LINE_THRU_DT, c2.CLM_THRU_DT) AS DATE) AS service_end_date,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CLM_LINE_PROD_REV_CTR_CD), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CLM_REV_APC_HIPPS_CD), '')) AS revenue_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code_system,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS place_of_service,
    CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_SRVC_UNIT_QTY AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS billed_units,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS capitation_indicator,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.HCPCS_1_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_1,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.HCPCS_2_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_2,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.HCPCS_3_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_3,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.HCPCS_4_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_4,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.HCPCS_5_MDFR_CD), '') AS modifier_5,
    3 AS source_priority
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c2 c2
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_cby (Demonstration keys-only stub - Priority 4)
  SELECT
    cby.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cby.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(cby.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    CONCAT(cby.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, '-', CAST(cby.CLM_LINE_NUM AS STRING)) AS source_line_id,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS service_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS service_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS revenue_code_system,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS place_of_service,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS billed_units,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS capitation_indicator,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_1,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_2,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_3,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_4,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS modifier_5,
    4 AS source_priority
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_cby cby
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(cby.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(cby.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(cby.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_lines AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY source_system, source_claim_id, line_number
           ORDER BY source_priority
         ) AS rn
  FROM union_lines
)
SELECT
  batch_id,
  record_hash,
  created_by,
  created_at,
  updated_by,
  updated_at,
  source_system,
  is_active,
  source_claim_id,
  line_number,
  source_line_id,
  service_date,
  service_end_date,
  revenue_code,
  revenue_code_system,
  place_of_service,
  billed_units,
  capitation_indicator,
  modifier_1,
  modifier_2,
  modifier_3,
  modifier_4,
  modifier_5
FROM ranked_lines
WHERE rn = 1;


-- =====================================================================
-- 3) vw_claim_diagnosis
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_diagnosis AS
WITH diagnosis_union AS (
  -- cclf_c1 Admitting Diagnosis (sequence 0)
  SELECT
    c1.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.ADMTG_DGNS_CD), '') AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '0' THEN 'ICD-10-CM'
         WHEN TRIM(c1.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '9' THEN 'ICD-9-CM'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    0 AS diagnosis_sequence,
    'admitting' AS diagnosis_type,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS poa_flag
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c1 c1
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.ADMTG_DGNS_CD), '') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c1 Principal Diagnosis (sequence 1)
  SELECT
    c1.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.PRNCPL_DGNS_CD), '') AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c1.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '0' THEN 'ICD-10-CM'
         WHEN TRIM(c1.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '9' THEN 'ICD-9-CM'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    1 AS diagnosis_sequence,
    'principal' AS diagnosis_type,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS poa_flag
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c1 c1
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c1.PRNCPL_DGNS_CD), '') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c4 Secondary Diagnoses (sequence 11..99)
  SELECT
    c4.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c4.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c4.CLM_DGNS_CD), '') AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c4.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '0' THEN 'ICD-10-CM'
         WHEN TRIM(c4.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '9' THEN 'ICD-9-CM'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    CAST(10 + CAST(c4.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM AS INT) AS INT) AS diagnosis_sequence,
    'secondary' AS diagnosis_type,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c4.CLM_POA_IND), '') AS poa_flag
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c4 c4
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c4.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c4.CLM_DGNS_CD), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c4.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c4.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM AS INT) >= 1

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c5 Wide Secondary Diagnoses CLM_DGNS_1..12 (sequence 101..112)
  SELECT
    c5.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(pos.code), '') AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c5.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '0' THEN 'ICD-10-CM'
         WHEN TRIM(c5.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '9' THEN 'ICD-9-CM'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    pos.seq AS diagnosis_sequence,
    'secondary' AS diagnosis_type,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS poa_flag
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c5 c5
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct(101, c5.CLM_DGNS_1_CD),
    struct(102, c5.CLM_DGNS_2_CD),
    struct(103, c5.CLM_DGNS_3_CD),
    struct(104, c5.CLM_DGNS_4_CD),
    struct(105, c5.CLM_DGNS_5_CD),
    struct(106, c5.CLM_DGNS_6_CD),
    struct(107, c5.CLM_DGNS_7_CD),
    struct(108, c5.CLM_DGNS_8_CD),
    struct(109, c5.CLM_DGNS_9_CD),
    struct(110, c5.CLM_DGNS_10_CD),
    struct(111, c5.CLM_DGNS_11_CD),
    struct(112, c5.CLM_DGNS_12_CD)
  )) pos(seq, code)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(pos.code), '') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c5 Line-level Diagnoses (sequence 201..)
  SELECT
    c5.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_DGNS_CD), '') AS source_diagnosis_code,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(c5.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '0' THEN 'ICD-10-CM'
         WHEN TRIM(c5.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '9' THEN 'ICD-9-CM'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS source_diagnosis_code_system,
    CAST(200 + CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS INT) AS diagnosis_sequence,
    'secondary' AS diagnosis_type,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS poa_flag
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c5 c5
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_DGNS_CD), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_diagnosis AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY source_system, source_claim_id, source_diagnosis_code
           ORDER BY diagnosis_sequence
         ) AS rn
  FROM diagnosis_union
)
SELECT
  batch_id,
  record_hash,
  created_by,
  created_at,
  updated_by,
  updated_at,
  source_system,
  is_active,
  source_claim_id,
  source_diagnosis_code,
  source_diagnosis_code_system,
  diagnosis_sequence,
  diagnosis_type,
  poa_flag
FROM ranked_diagnosis
WHERE rn = 1;


-- =====================================================================
-- 4) vw_claim_procedure
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_procedure AS
SELECT
  c3.batch_id AS batch_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
  'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
  'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
  'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
  CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c3.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
  0 AS line_number,
  CAST(c3.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM AS INT) AS procedure_sequence,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c3.CLM_PRCDR_CD), '') AS source_procedure_code,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(c3.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '0' THEN 'ICD-10-PCS'
       WHEN TRIM(c3.DGNS_PRCDR_ICD_IND) = '9' THEN 'ICD-9-PCS'
       ELSE NULL
  END AS source_procedure_code_system,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS procedure_type,
  CAST(COALESCE(c3.CLM_PRCDR_PRFRM_DT, c3.CLM_FROM_DT) AS DATE) AS procedure_date
FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c3 c3
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c3.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(c3.CLM_PRCDR_CD), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(c3.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(c3.CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL;


-- =====================================================================
-- 5) vw_claim_provider
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_provider AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  batch_id,
  record_hash,
  created_by,
  created_at,
  updated_by,
  updated_at,
  source_system,
  is_active,
  source_claim_id,
  line_number,
  provider_role_code,
  provider_role_system,
  provider_identifier_system,
  provider_identifier_value,
  npi,
  tin
FROM (
  -- cclf_c1 (Header scope provider NPI unpivot)
  SELECT
    c1.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    0 AS line_number,
    p.role_code AS provider_role_code,
    'X12' AS provider_role_system,
    CASE WHEN p.npi IS NOT NULL THEN 'NPI' ELSE 'OSCAR' END AS provider_identifier_system,
    COALESCE(p.npi, NULLIF(TRIM(c1.PRVDR_OSCAR_NUM), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BLG_PRVDR_OSCAR_NUM), '')) AS provider_identifier_value,
    p.npi AS npi,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tin
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c1 c1
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct('OPERATING', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.OPRTG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_OPRTG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''))),
    struct('ATTENDING', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.ATNDG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_ATNDG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''))),
    struct('FACILITY', NULLIF(TRIM(c1.FAC_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),'')),
    struct('BILLING', NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BLG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),'')),
    struct('REFERRING', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c1.OTHR_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_OTHR_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),'')))
  )) p(role_code, npi)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(p.npi, NULLIF(TRIM(c1.PRVDR_OSCAR_NUM), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CLM_BLG_PRVDR_OSCAR_NUM), '')) IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c5 (Line scope provider NPI unpivot - rendering & referring)
  SELECT
    c5.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    p.role_code AS provider_role_code,
    'X12' AS provider_role_system,
    'NPI' AS provider_identifier_system,
    p.npi AS provider_identifier_value,
    p.npi AS npi,
    CASE WHEN p.role_code = 'RENDERING' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_RNDRG_PRVDR_TAX_NUM), '') ELSE NULL END AS tin
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c5 c5
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct('RENDERING', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c5.RNDRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''), NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_RNDRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''))),
    struct('REFERRING', NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_RFRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''))
  )) p(role_code, npi)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    AND p.npi IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c6 (Line scope provider NPI unpivot - billing & referring & ordering)
  SELECT
    c6.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    p.role_code AS provider_role_code,
    'X12' AS provider_role_system,
    'NPI' AS provider_identifier_system,
    p.npi AS provider_identifier_value,
    p.npi AS npi,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tin
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c6 c6
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct('BILLING', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c6.PAYTO_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''), NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_BLG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''))),
    struct('REFERRING', NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_RFRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),'')),
    struct('REFERRING', NULLIF(TRIM(c6.ORDRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM),''))
  )) p(role_code, npi)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    AND p.npi IS NOT NULL
) AS provider_stack;


-- =====================================================================
-- 6) vw_claim_line_adjudication
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_line_adjudication AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  batch_id,
  record_hash,
  created_by,
  created_at,
  updated_by,
  updated_at,
  source_system,
  is_active,
  source_claim_id,
  line_number,
  adjudication_type,
  adjudication_category_code,
  adjudication_category_bb_code,
  adjudication_category_system,
  adjudication_reason_code,
  adjudication_reason_system,
  amount,
  currency,
  value
FROM (
  -- cclf_c2 (Institutional line adjudication - paid only)
  SELECT
    c2.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_type,
    'paid' AS adjudication_category_code,
    'paid' AS adjudication_category_bb_code,
    'FHIR' AS adjudication_category_system,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_reason_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_reason_system,
    CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_CVRD_PD_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS amount,
    'USD' AS currency,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS value
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c2 c2
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c2.CLM_LINE_CVRD_PD_AMT), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c2.CLM_LINE_CVRD_PD_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4)) IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c5 (Professional line adjudication - paid and eligible)
  SELECT
    c5.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_type,
    p.category_code AS adjudication_category_code,
    p.category_code AS adjudication_category_bb_code,
    'FHIR' AS adjudication_category_system,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_CARR_PMT_DNL_CD), '') AS adjudication_reason_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_reason_system,
    p.amt AS amount,
    'USD' AS currency,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS value
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c5 c5
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct('paid', CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_CVRD_PD_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4))),
    struct('eligible', CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_ALOWD_CHRG_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4)))
  )) p(category_code, amt)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c5.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    AND p.amt IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- cclf_c6 (DME line adjudication - paid and eligible)
  SELECT
    c6.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) AS line_number,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_type,
    p.category_code AS adjudication_category_code,
    p.category_code AS adjudication_category_bb_code,
    'FHIR' AS adjudication_category_system,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_CARR_PMT_DNL_CD), '') AS adjudication_reason_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_reason_system,
    p.amt AS amount,
    'USD' AS currency,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS value
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c6 c6
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct('paid', CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_CVRD_PD_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4))),
    struct('eligible', CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_ALOWD_CHRG_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4)))
  )) p(category_code, amt)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(c6.CLM_LINE_NUM AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    AND p.amt IS NOT NULL
) AS adjudication_stack;


-- =====================================================================
-- 7) vw_pharmacy_claim_header
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_pharmacy_claim_header AS
SELECT
  batch_id AS batch_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
  FALSE AS is_deleted,
  'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
  'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
  'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
  CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
  'RX' AS claim_type,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS external_claim_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BENE_MBI_ID), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(BENE_HIC_NUM), '')) AS patient_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS primary_payer_id,
  CAST(CLM_EFCTV_DT AS DATE) AS claim_effective_date,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CLM_DSPNSNG_STUS_CD), '') AS claim_status,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS denial_reason,
  CAST(NULL AS INT) AS quantity_units
FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c7
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL;


-- =====================================================================
-- 8) vw_patient
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_patient AS
SELECT
  c8.batch_id AS batch_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
  'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
  'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
  'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
  CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_MBI_ID), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_HIC_NUM), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c9.CRNT_NUM), '')) AS source_member_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_MBI_ID), ''), CASE WHEN TRIM(c9.HICN_MBI_XREF_IND) = 'M' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(c9.CRNT_NUM), '') ELSE NULL END) AS mbi_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_HIC_NUM), ''), CASE WHEN TRIM(c9.HICN_MBI_XREF_IND) = 'H' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(c9.PRVS_NUM), '') ELSE NULL END) AS hicn,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_1ST_NAME), '') AS first_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_MIDL_NAME), '') AS middle_name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LAST_NAME), '') AS last_name,
  CAST(c8.BENE_DOB AS DATE) AS date_of_birth,
  CAST(c8.BENE_DEATH_DT AS DATE) AS deceased_date,
  (NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_DEATH_DT), '') IS NOT NULL) AS death_indicator,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(c8.BENE_SEX_CD) IN ('1', 'M') THEN 'MALE'
       WHEN TRIM(c8.BENE_SEX_CD) IN ('2', 'F') THEN 'FEMALE'
       WHEN TRIM(c8.BENE_SEX_CD) = '0' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
       ELSE 'OTHER'
  END AS gender,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_RACE_CD), '') AS race_code,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ethnicity_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LINE_1_ADR), '') AS address_line1,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LINE_2_ADR), '') AS address_line2,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.GEO_ZIP_PLC_NAME), '') AS city,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.GEO_USPS_STATE_CD), '') AS state,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_ZIP_CD), '') AS zip_code,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS country,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LINE_3_ADR), '') AS address_line3,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LINE_4_ADR), '') AS address_line4,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LINE_5_ADR), '') AS address_line5,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_LINE_6_ADR), '') AS address_line6,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_FIPS_CNTY_CD), '') AS county_fips_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_FIPS_STATE_CD), '') AS state_fips_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.GEO_ZIP5_CD), '') AS zip5,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.GEO_ZIP4_CD), '') AS zip4,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_MDCR_STUS_CD), '') AS mdcr_status_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_DUAL_STUS_CD), '') AS dual_status_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_ORGNL_ENTLMT_RSN_CD), '') AS original_entitlement_reason_code,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_ENTLMT_BUYIN_IND), '') AS entitlement_buyin_indicator,
  CAST(c8.BENE_PART_A_ENRLMT_BGN_DT AS DATE) AS part_a_enrollment_begin_date,
  CAST(c8.BENE_PART_B_ENRLMT_BGN_DT AS DATE) AS part_b_enrollment_begin_date,
  CAST(COALESCE(c8.BENE_RNG_BGN_DT, c9.PRVS_ID_EFCTV_DT) AS DATE) AS bene_rng_bgn_dt,
  CAST(COALESCE(c8.BENE_RNG_END_DT, c9.PRVS_ID_OBSLT_DT) AS DATE) AS bene_rng_end_dt
FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c8 c8
LEFT JOIN cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c9 c9 ON (c8.BENE_MBI_ID = c9.CRNT_NUM OR c8.BENE_HIC_NUM = c9.CRNT_NUM)
WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_MBI_ID), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c8.BENE_HIC_NUM), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c9.CRNT_NUM), '')) IS NOT NULL;


-- =====================================================================
-- 9) vw_claim_adjudication
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cinqdev.silverraw_claims.vw_claim_adjudication AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  batch_id,
  record_hash,
  is_deleted,
  created_by,
  created_at,
  updated_by,
  updated_at,
  source_system,
  is_active,
  source_claim_id,
  adjudication_type,
  adjudication_category_code,
  adjudication_category_system,
  adjudication_reason_code,
  adjudication_reason_system,
  amount,
  currency,
  value
FROM (
  SELECT
    c1.batch_id AS batch_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS record_hash,
    FALSE AS is_deleted,
    'claim_pipeline' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
    'claim_pipeline' AS updated_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at,
    'D0284_CCLF' AS source_system,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') AS source_claim_id,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_type,
    p.category_code AS adjudication_category_code,
    'FHIR' AS adjudication_category_system,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_reason_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS adjudication_reason_system,
    p.amt AS amount,
    'USD' AS currency,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS value
  FROM cinqdev.bronze_claims.cclf_c1 c1
  LATERAL VIEW inline(array(
    struct('paid', CAST(c1.CLM_PMT_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4))),
    struct('submitted', CAST(c1.CLM_MDCR_INSTNL_TOT_CHRG_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,4)))
  )) p(category_code, amt)
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c1.CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND p.amt IS NOT NULL
) AS adjudication_stack;
